fields.label: Key
fields.description: Stable identifier the Compass card selects on (bob_kes, coop, abc, mpesa…). Never renamed.

fields.label: Reference
fields.description: Bank a/c number · QBO account id.

fields.label: Bank Sourced
fields.description: 0 = there is no current statement for this account. A zero balance and no source are different facts and must not both read as 0.

fields.label: Bank Available
fields.description: What may be drawn today: the ledger balance net of uncleared items and, on Baroda, the OD arrangement. Differs from bank_balance by 1.85M across the KES accounts on 2026-07-25.

fields.label: Bank Available Present
fields.description: Currency columns cannot be NULL, so a missing figure reads as 0.00. Baroda USD carries no Available in the tracker — this flag keeps that a blank rather than a confident zero.

fields.label: Bank Source
fields.description: Which source won for this row: bank_tracker | statement | erpnext_ledger. Shown so a figure can always be traced without opening the job.

fields.label: Bank As At
fields.description: Per-row stamp. The tracker carries Finance's control date while M-PESA is live, so one date on the document would overstate freshness.

fields.label: Status
fields.options:
open
ties
no_statement
stale
not_in_erp
books_differ
unallocated
